DATASET — WHAT'S LOADED
Chapters 50–63 ship embedded from the USITC schedule. Add or refresh any chapter from a USITC export.
ChCoverageLinesSource
To load Footwear (64) and Headgear (65): open
https://hts.usitc.gov/reststop/exportList?from=6401&to=6506&format=CSV
save the file, and import it here (JSON and XLSX exports work too). The import is parsed locally, persisted in this browser, and included in the merged-dataset download — commit that selvedge-data.json next to this HTML on GitHub Pages and every visitor gets 64/65 automatically. The same import path refreshes chapters 50–63 whenever a new HTS revision lands.
CANDIDATE LINES
Candidates rank by spec-match; amber flags list what to confirm before filing.
Pick a mode, describe the goods, and classify. Results include the trade-remedy overlay for the origin you set.
BATCH — ONE WORKBOOK, FIVE SHEETS
Download the template, fill any sheet(s) — Fabrics, Apparel, MadeUps, Footwear, Headgear — one item per row using the dropdowns, upload it back. Results come back on screen and as a styled workbook with per-row HTS options, trade-remedy flags and confirm-notes.
Selvedge proposes candidate lines from the loaded HTS revision — it is decision support, not a ruling. Final classification, PGA flags and entry treatment are the licensed broker's call. Verify rates and Ch 99 overlays at hts.usitc.gov as of the entry date.
